description: Approved follow-up steps 2-3: replace unscoped external-ID rating lookup and its obsolete tests; preserve generic bridge rating pipeline, mapper, Person identity and permission checks, source isolation, canonical UUID and shared upsert. Real integration regressions first. Separate Engine resolution and Channels normalization, no provider parsing in Engine. Reuse SourceIdentity and TranscriptHistory authorization. comments.text: Implemented and issue-validated, uncommitted. All Jido adapters use {:source, reference} in shared rating dispatch. Provider/connector/native room/source scope/external message ID resolve canonical target; normalized Thread/ChannelRef native coordinates fix Telegram prefix mismatch. Active rater uses existing People.match_by_channel; existing TranscriptHistory access verifies placement before message-lock serialized shared upsert. Canonical Person rating actor only. Real bridge->Engine->DB tests cover Mattermost/Telegram/Discord/Slack, passive external and assistant targets, conflicting old rows, isolation, unknown/inaccessible actors; property covers identical IDs across two connectors/two Telegram chats. Final 635 tests + 12 properties, mix q, diff check pass; email regression suite included. No final PR acceptance or commit.

Reopened production-path defect after user live Mattermost reaction failed. Prior tests seeded canonical capture, bypassing finalization+delivery.
